summary: A large coral-reef wrasse whose adults develop a prominent forehead hump. Demand from the reef-fish trade has contributed to overexploitation; international trade is regulated under CITES.

features: Two dark lines extending behind the eye
Blue-green adult head with fine winding lines

habitat.description: Indo-Pacific coral reefs, commonly at depths of 5–60 metres.

malaysia.rules: Listed in CITES Appendix II: international trade is controlled, rather than unrestricted. Malaysian permit requirements must be checked with the Department of Fisheries; this is not a statement that catching or trading the fish is automatically permitted.

eating: Traded as a high-value reef fish; market demand has put pressure on wild stocks.
